title: VLRMBench: A Comprehensive and Challenging Benchmark for Vision-Language Reward Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether models assign higher scores based on the presentation order of reasoning processes by swapping the order of superior and inferior candidate responses (e.g., 'Better first' vs. 'Better second') in the Multi-solution Judgment (MJ) task.

Evaluating model robustness by injecting confident and assertive terms (e.g., 'definitely', 'without a doubt') into incorrect reasoning steps to test if the model is misled into perceiving erroneous reasoning as correct (Confidence Misdirection task).
